lab.desde: You came from “{seccion}” in the Nursery: this is the heartbeat step that explains it.
lab.truncada: Truncated recording: read up to the last complete line
lab.directo_vacio: There is no live life with heartbeats yet.
lab.latido_no_esta: Heartbeat {n} is not in this source (it keeps {max}).
lab.sin_fuente_texto: Start a life from the lobby (it can be opened live without recording it) or open a recording.
lab.detalle_vacio: Click a heartbeat step to see its pieces, its Components and its time; a piece, for its log; a Component, for its card.
lab.detalle_vacio_ing: Click a Component to see its card: what it does, its biological analogue, its design decision and its time.
lab.paso.onda.que: Each heartbeat starts with a new Wave: it copies what the previous one left (its ef becomes this one's ei) and the previous one goes to short-term memory.
lab.paso.onda.bio: Like a cortical processing cycle: each moment starts from the state the previous one left.
lab.paso.sentir.que: The Core's sensors turn what the world gives into raw pieces, without judging them: the body from inside, posture and what is outside.
lab.paso.sentir.bio: Sensory transduction: receptors turn stimuli into signals, before any judgement.
lab.paso.preatencion.que: Annotates what was sensed with its salience and a quick appraisal (danger, nourishment, novelty). It costs no attention and also runs asleep.
lab.paso.preatencion.bio: Bottom-up salience and innate appraisal in parallel and before the attention bottleneck (superior colliculus, the amygdala's fast route).
lab.paso.plasticidad.que: Each learning Component learns from the effect of the previous heartbeat's action, in its own part of memory.
lab.paso.plasticidad.bio: Synaptic plasticity is local and costs no attention; the eligibility trace tags what was active when acting.
lab.paso.regulacion.que: Instant rules set the heartbeat's deadline, how many pieces fit in attention (amplitude) and how much arousal can be given (power).
lab.paso.regulacion.bio: Brainstem arousal systems (locus coeruleus, reticular formation) set processing gain and pace from the body's state.
lab.paso.S1.que: The fast system: it interprets what threatens or feeds and proposes actions per need (flee, eat, take shelter). It spends attention first.
lab.paso.S1.bio: Subcortical survival circuits: amygdala, hypothalamus and periaqueductal grey.
lab.paso.S2.que: Recognises the familiar, values it by what was lived and felt, and proposes to explore, take refuge or return to remembered food.
lab.paso.S2.bio: Limbic and valuation system: hippocampus, ventral striatum and orbitofrontal cortex.
lab.paso.S3.que: Reasons with what it knows: propositions, beliefs and intentions; plans towards goals and corrects S1 and S2 when it is certain.
lab.paso.S3.bio: Prefrontal cortex: working memory, top-down control and planning. Under acute stress it gets no turn.
lab.paso.tribunal.que: Compares the Actions proposed by S1, S2 and S3 and picks one: under stress urgency rules; when calm, confidence; experience biases a little.
lab.paso.tribunal.bio: Action selection in the basal ganglia: several proposals compete and one is disinhibited.
lab.paso.actuar.que: The Core executes the decision as world primitives (the body's motor layer translates the intention) and judges whether it worked.
lab.paso.actuar.bio: Motor cortex and spinal cord: intention becomes muscle synergies; the cerebellum compares the predicted with what happened.
lab.paso.cierre.que: Tags what to keep (by arousal and feedback), forms episodes from short-term memory and updates the body's indicators.
lab.paso.cierre.bio: Early consolidation: what was intense and mattered is tagged for episodic memory (hippocampus).
lab.latido_ayuda: The Wave (yellow dot) travels through the steps and lingers where more time was spent. Click a step for its detail.
lab.latido_ayuda_quieto: Reduced motion: the heartbeat is shown without animation. Click a step for its detail.
lab.sin_tiempo_regulacion: not timed separately: computed when the Wave is created
lab.solo_aprende: no time of its own: learns in step 4
lab.regulacion_fase_a: when the Wave is created (phase A, D12)
lab.amplitud_ayuda: New pieces this system put into attention, over the heartbeat's maximum
lab.potencia_ayuda: Arousal this system gave or changed, over the heartbeat's maximum
lab.sin_piezas: This step creates or modifies no pieces in this heartbeat.
lab.sin_completo: This record is not at the full level: per-Component times and each piece's log are missing.
lab.tribunal_formula: base = arousal × stress + confidence × (1 − stress); active and proactive: experience bias; plus: continuity with what was already being done.
lab.cambio_experiencia: Experience changed the decision in this heartbeat.
lab.plus_decide: The continuity plus decided the winner.
lab.plasticidad_sin_tiempo: The record times plasticity as a whole, not each Component.
lab.pieza_no_esta: That piece is not in this heartbeat.
lab.registro_pieza: Log (who created it and who touched it)
lab.preatentivo_ayuda: Runs in pre-attention (step 3): costs no attention and keeps running asleep
lab.plastico_ayuda: Learns in step 4 (plasticity) from the previous action's effect
lab.sin_analogo: No honest biological analogue: it is a piece of IdA's engineering.
lab.sin_tiempo: No time of its own in the record: its work happens in plasticity.
lab.sin_tiempo_estrategia: A strategy runs inside its system's Strategy Component: it has no time of its own.
lab.sin_tiempo_biblioteca: A body library runs inside whoever uses it: it has no time of its own.
lab.decision_previa: Older than the reorganisation into Components (no decision of its own).
lab.sin_ficha: There is no card for “{autor}” in the Component map.

lab.subtitulo: How IdA works inside: heartbeat by heartbeat, what it knows, what it feels and how it changes.
lab.desde_vista.epistemologia: You came from «{seccion}» in the Nursery: here is what it knows throughout its life and how it came to know it.
lab.desde_vista.analisis: You came from «{seccion}» in the Nursery: here the lineages of this world are compared, generation by generation.
lab.detalle_vacio_epistemologia: Click a piece of knowledge to see its full history: when it is born, how its confidence changes and where it comes from. Click a chart to go to that heartbeat.
lab.detalle_vacio_biologia: Click a chart to go to that heartbeat: the scene and the summary above follow it.
lab.detalle_vacio_analisis: In «This life», click a chart to go to that heartbeat.
lab.detalle_vacio_cierre: The summary of the life being viewed; with several lives, pick one above.
epi.titulo: What it knows and how it knows it
epi.ayuda: Each proposition is born as a hypothesis, gains or loses confidence with experience and may be proven, become doubtful again or be refuted. Requirements say what an action needs and what it yields. Figures at the heartbeat being viewed.
epi.rpe_ayuda: {n} expectation {n|surprise|surprises}: above, better than expected; below, worse (rpe: obtained − expected). It is what moves dopamine (Biology).
epi.aviso_cognitivo: Cognitive-level recording: the record carries the 20 most confident propositions. One that leaves those 20 is «outside» (its confidence is not visible) until it comes back; its facts are still visible. The full level shows all knowledge.
epi.aviso_vital: Vital-level recording: without the «saber» field, each proposition's history comes only from its facts (learns, doubts, refutes).
epi.sin_saber: That knowledge is not in this source.
epi.historia_ayuda: One row per change of state, confidence or source, and per fact. † = at death (closing record). Click a heartbeat to go to it.
bio.ayuda: Body, chemistry and affect heartbeat by heartbeat, with facts marked and sleep in blue. Each series states its biological analogue when it has one; the table at the end says what it does in the code.
bio.cuerpo_ayuda: The body's constants with this world's names (0 to 100). Those the world does not use are not shown.
bio.afecto_ayuda: Valence goes from −1 (unpleasant) to 1 (pleasant). The emotion's arousal is stress: S2's emotion carries stress as its arousal.
bio.tabla_ayuda: What each series does in the code and its biological analogue. Those without an honest one have none.
bio.que.vitalidad: Body health. In minimal and files: rises while asleep and fed (+1) and while awake, well fed and rested (+0.5); without food it drops 2 per heartbeat. In Crafter it is the game's health.
bio.que.alimentacion: Drops 0.5 per heartbeat while awake (0.8 when carrying something) and rises with what it eats; in Crafter, the lower of the game's food and drink.
bio.que.energia: Rises 0.3 per heartbeat when fed (drops 1 otherwise) and 3 while asleep; in Crafter it is the game's energy.
bio.que.descanso: Drops 0.3 per heartbeat awake and rises 4 asleep; it wakes rested when above 95 (with energy 85 or more).
bio.que.dormido: Asleep it can only sleep or wait; it wakes by alarm (nearby danger of 0.6 or more, or critical hunger) or rested.
bio.que.dopamina: Rises or falls with the reward prediction error of what was learnt (×2, between −20 and 20) and returns 15 % per heartbeat to its baseline, 35. No Component reads it to decide: it is a readout, not a modulator.
bio.que.placer: Rises twice what is eaten and drops 1 per heartbeat. It feeds valence and S1 and S2 expectations.
bio.que.estres: Moving average (0.7 / 0.3 per heartbeat) of urgency: danger or critical hunger. Halved by high pleasure. In the Tribunal it weighs arousal against confidence: with high stress the urgent wins, with low stress the confident.
bio.que.activacion: Not a separate series: S2's emotion carries stress as its arousal.
bio.que.estado: Thresholds on danger, stress, hunger, tiredness and novelty: asleep, panic, fear, alert, tiredness, curiosity or calm.
bio.que.peligro: The highest danger × proximity of what is perceived (or the survival signal when there is no critical hunger).
bio.que.tension: The mean arousal of the heartbeat's cognitive pieces (everything not coming from the sensors).
bio.que.calma: 1 minus the highest of danger, tension and stress.
bio.que.necesidad: The deficit (0 to 1) of each need the world declares, from interoception and the body.
bio.analogo.alimentacion: Approximate analogue: energy reserves and satiety (blood glucose, liver stores), spent over time and activity and replenished by eating.
bio.analogo.descanso: Homeostatic sleep pressure (process S of the two-process model), inverted: it builds up awake and dissipates asleep.
bio.analogo.dormido: Sleep with motor atonia and an arousal threshold: a threat stimulus or a critical need interrupts it.
bio.analogo.dopamina: Phasic midbrain dopamine as reward prediction error: it rises when things go better than expected, falls when worse, and returns to its tonic baseline.
bio.analogo.placer: Hedonic pleasure («liking»), distinct from dopaminergic «wanting»: the pleasurable response to consumption, which fades on its own.
bio.analogo.estres: Approximate analogue of the acute stress response (noradrenaline and the hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal axis): it integrates threat over a few heartbeats and shifts decisions from deliberate to reactive.
bio.analogo.valencia: Core affect valence: the pleasant–unpleasant axis of mood.
bio.analogo.activacion: Core affect arousal: the calm–excited axis, which here is stress.
bio.analogo.estado: Approximate analogue: basic emotions as discrete states (fear, panic, alert, curiosity) triggered by thresholds.
bio.analogo.peligro: Threat detection (amygdala): the salience of nearby danger.
bio.analogo.necesidad: Interoceptive signals of homeostatic deficit: the drive that pushes to replenish what is missing.
bio.analogo_corto.estado: Approximate analogue: basic emotions as discrete states, triggered by thresholds.
bio.analogo_corto.necesidad: Analogue: interoceptive signals of homeostatic deficit (the drive to replenish what is missing).
ana.ayuda.vida: The curves of the open source: score, achievements, knowledge and amplitude and power use, with guillotines in red.
ana.ayuda.grabaciones: Two recordings from the list aligned by heartbeat. If they share configuration and do not diverge, they are the same life; if they diverge, the red line marks the first differing heartbeat.
ana.ayuda.estirpes: Two lineages from the collection (the companion, archived ones and this world's cards), generation by generation.
ana.score_ayuda: The collection and lineage score (ida/historico.py): not D17's official Score, which cannot be given per heartbeat.
ana.sin_score: With a file loaded in the browser the collection score is not computed (it lives on the server): the world's score is shown.
ana.sin_grabaciones: There are no recordings in the list. Record a life from the Nursery or the lobby.
ana.misma_configuracion: Same configuration (world, seed, options, character, logical deadline and experience).
ana.divergencia: First divergence at heartbeat {latido} (life {vida}), after {n} identical {n|heartbeat|heartbeats}: {campos}.
ana.misma_vida: The same life: {n} common {n|heartbeat, identical|heartbeats, all identical} except timings.
ana.sin_divergencia: No divergence in {n} common {n|heartbeat|heartbeats}, although the configuration differs.
ana.alineadas: Aligned by heartbeat (life and heartbeat); positions only one has are blank in the other. Records are compared without timing fields, scene and level.
ana.sin_estirpes: There are no {mundo} lineages in the collection: no companion, archived lineage or card.
ana.otro_mundo: The two lineages are from different worlds: their scores are not measured the same way.
ana.estirpe_ayuda: Aligned by generation number. Lineage retention (20 generations, the highest scoring) may leave gaps: that side is empty.
cierre.ayuda: The summary of a life and what it learnt on dying: the closing record comes after the last heartbeat, with what changed in memory because of the action that killed it.
cierre.no_murio: It did not die: the source ends at heartbeat {latido}.
cierre.recortada: The live memory no longer keeps the start of this life; it ends at heartbeat {latido}.
cierre.sin_nacimiento: The source starts mid-life, at heartbeat {latido}.
cierre.aprendio_al_morir: On dying, {n} {n|thing|things} changed in its memory:
cierre.nada_al_morir: Nothing it knows changed on dying (the action that killed it taught nothing new).
cierre.notas_ayuda: As the engine writes them (in Spanish): the console's notes.
cierre.sin_registro: No closing record: the life did not end by death in this source.
cierre.sin_registro_muerte: It died, but this source has no closing record (recorded before T4b or cut short).
cierre.saber: What it knew at the start and at the end
cierre.sin_resumen: This source has no knowledge summary (before T4b).
cierre.saber_ayuda: From the knowledge summary (resumen_saber) of the first and last record of the life in this source, including the closing one.
